title: Safe divide
hints: The results are **named** (`q`, `err`) on purpose: a deferred closure can still assign them after the panic has stopped the function body.

Put `defer func() { if r := recover(); r != nil { ... } }()` at the top of the function, then simply `return a / b, nil`. When `b == 0`, the division panics, the deferred closure runs, and `recover()` returns the run-time error value.
Inside the `if`: `q, err = 0, fmt.Errorf("safe divide: %v", r)`. `Average` is the same pattern: sum in a loop, then `return sum / len(nums), nil` and the prefix `"average: "`.
